dogecoin.text:
For those true believers (and MP obviously is a very true believer), the “success” of Dogecoin is deeply wrong and even immoral.
This psychological dynamic probably drives some of the Dogecoin narrative. From the start, Dogecoin was deliberately a story about being “not Bitcoin”.

We are told that, by definition, Dogecoin is a scam because it has taken slightly different engineering choices. It is also asserted that, by aiming for goals other than currency speculation, Dogecoin is morally corrupt and criminal. Oh, and it operates like (the hated enemy),
